notes: Account summary: Springforge builds agent-facing guidance for B2B contact centers. Looking for low-latency streaming suggestions + safe tool-calls into Zendesk and internal CRMs. Very sensitive to tail latency and uptime during promotional spikes.
Primary goals: realtime suggestion stream, ticket summarization post-call, secure function/tool calling for actions (create ticket, update customer record), graceful fallback under overload.

Perf targets discussed: mean suggestion latency < 80ms; p95 < 200ms at baseline (200 concurrent agents); system must sustain 10x bursts for marketing/flash-sales windows with automatic graceful degradation and deterministic fallbacks.

Guardrails & safety: explicit hallucination filters, confidence thresholds per suggestion, agent-visible provenance (source docs / KB snippet), manual override always available; audit log of tool calls for compliance.

Integrations: Genesys Cloud (telephony), STT vendor: Google Speech streaming (we use), CRM: Zendesk + internal REST API; need signed short-lived tokens for tool-calls; KMS for key management; log retention controls per EU residency rules.

POC approach (agreed): Phase 1 (hosted API quickstart, 2 weeks) — wire end-to-end for streaming suggestions to 20 pilot agents; Phase 2 (dedicated/private sizing) — run 200-agent baseline + synthetic 10x spike tests; Phase 3 — security/hardening and SLA negotiation.

POC success criteria: suggestion relevance >= 0.75 (human eval on 200 prompts), p95 latency <200ms under baseline, deterministic fallback path tested (no more than 1% suggestion failures), tool-call audit logs present and queryable.
